familySummary: Meta coffee tables offer simple, clean-lined forms in round and rectangular sizes, with Brown options and MDF, Wood veneer finishes for a coordinated living space.
familyDescription: The Meta coffee table family brings together pared-back shapes in a practical range of sizes for different living room layouts. Round and rectangular options make it easy to choose a table that suits the scale and arrangement of your seating area. Each design is offered in MDF, Wood veneer, with selected versions in Brown. The collection includes compact and longer formats, giving the Meta range a consistent look across multiple table proportions.
